note: A release promo says one thing and says it at the end. No text runs over the body: the previous attempt put '506 BEATS / 3,520 ACCENTS' on screen, which is the system talking about itself, and a viewer has no reason to care. The card names the artist, the track and the licence -- all three are facts, and the licence is there because a public-domain record is the reason this can be published at all.
